The '''JM-28 assault cannon''' was a type of portable [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The JM-28 assault cannon was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Pursuer's Bounty Pack.
